You can also get COSC 101 credit through the Computer Science AP A exam. The CS major page requires a score of 3 or better [12], but the EE major page says 5 or better [26], so confirm with your advisor which applies to you.
- **COSC 111 (Computational Thinking and the Art of Programming)** is another intro course. Its description says it welcomes students with limited or no programming experience [31].
